data.name: SavingNotice
data.comment: Notice while Finalization turns the Working file into the Recording file.

data.name: SavedAsWav
data.value: Saved {0} as WAV: this edition of Windows has no MP3 encoder. To save MP3 files, install the Media Feature Pack (Settings › Apps › Optional features › Add a feature).
data.comment: {0}: path of the Recording file, a WAV because the MP3 encoder is missing (Windows N editions).

data.name: CannotFinalize
data.value: Couldn't save the Recording file: {0} The unmixed recording was kept in {1}
data.comment: {0}: the error message; {1}: path of the Working file.

data.name: CannotStop
data.value: The Recording stopped with an error: {0}

data.name: SourceFailed
data.value: {0} is recorded as silence from now on: {1}
data.comment: {0}: Input or Output; {1}: the error message.

data.name: InputFallback
data.value: Your Input, {0}, isn't connected: recording the Windows default, {1}, in its place.
data.comment: Notice when the remembered Input is absent. {0}: name of the remembered Input; {1}: name of the Windows default Input.

data.name: OutputFallback
data.value: Your Output, {0}, isn't connected: recording the Windows default, {1}, in its place.
data.comment: Notice when the remembered Output is absent. {0}: name of the remembered Output; {1}: name of the Windows default Output.

data.name: ChooseFolder
data.value: Choose where to save Recording files
data.comment: Title of the destination folder picker.

data.name: CannotOpenFolder
data.comment: {0}: the destination folder; {1}: the error message.

data.name: RecoveryHeading
data.comment: Heading of the startup prompt for an Orphan Working file.

data.name: RecoveryText
data.value: {0} ({1}) was left unfinished, probably because Duettino or Windows closed while recording.
data.comment: {0}: file name of the Orphan Working file; {1}: its length (h:mm:ss) or RecoveryLengthUnknown.

data.name: RecoveryLengthUnknown
data.comment: Stands for the length of an Orphan Working file that can't be read.

data.name: RecoverDescription
data.value: Save it as a Recording file, as Stop does

data.name: DeleteDescription
data.value: Throw it away (into the Recycle Bin, where Windows keeps one)

data.name: LaterDescription
data.value: Keep it and ask again next time Duettino starts

data.name: CannotFindOrphans
data.value: Couldn't look for unfinished Recordings in {0}: {1}
data.comment: {0}: the destination folder; {1}: the error message.

data.name: CannotDelete
data.comment: {0}: path of the Orphan Working file; {1}: the error message.

data.name: StopAndSaveHeading
data.comment: Heading of the prompt shown when the window is closed during a Recording.

data.name: StopAndSaveText
data.value: Duettino is recording. It will stop, save the Recording file, then close.

data.name: KeepRecordingButton
data.comment: Dismisses the prompt: the Recording goes on and the window stays open.
